    """Model Category (table Category)."""

    id_ = IntegerProperty(unique_index=True, required=True, db_property="id")
    created_at = DateTimeNeo4jFormatProperty(default=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc))

class Post(StructuredNode):
    """Model Post (table Post)."""

    id_ = IntegerProperty(unique_index=True, required=True, db_property="id")
    created_at = DateTimeNeo4jFormatProperty(default=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc))
    updated_at = DateTimeNeo4jFormatProperty(required=True)
    public_id = StringProperty(required=True)
    title = StringProperty(max_length=200, required=True)
    body = StringProperty(required=True)
    status = StringProperty(
        choices={"draft": "DRAFT", "published": "PUBLISHED"},
        default="draft",
    )
    rating = StringProperty()
    view_count = IntegerProperty(default=0)
    is_featured = BooleanProperty(default=False)
    published_at = DateTimeNeo4jFormatProperty(
        default=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc),
    )
    metadata = JSONProperty(required=True)
    author_id = IntegerProperty(required=True)
    editor_id = IntegerProperty()
